blocks.text: Abbotsford condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to October 2026

Over the 13 months from October 2025 to October 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Abbotsford peaked at 633 in May 2026 and bottomed at 399 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in March 2026 with 105. The reported sale price moved from $532,450 to $440,000, a change of −17.4%.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Abbotsford?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 546 condos and townhomes listed in Abbotsford and 89 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The October report gave $440,000 for condos and townhomes in Abbotsford, against $497,500 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The October report showed 30 days on market for condos and townhomes in Abbotsford and a sale-to-list price ratio of 98%, against 32 days the month before.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Abbotsford?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Abbotsford freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
